import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a 1x2 subplot
fig, axes = plt.subplots(nrows=1, ncols=2, figsize=(14, 6))

# Plot 1: Countplot of transaction types
sns.countplot(data=data, x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', ax=axes[0])
axes[0].set_title('Transaction Type vs Fraud Status')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[0].legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right')

# Plot 2: Boxplot of amount by hour_of_day colored by fraud status
sns.boxplot(data=data, x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', ax=axes[1])
axes[1].set_title('Transaction Amount by Hour and Fraud Status')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Transaction Amount')
axes[1].legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right')

# Adjust the layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
